single.rationale: Macy's shows declining revenue (4-year CAGR of -3.9%) and faces structural headwinds in department store retail, but trades at attractive valuations (8.1x P/E, 20.3% FCF yield) with disciplined capital allocation. The Bold New Chapter strategy shows some traction with positive comp sales and improved margins, but execution risk remains high amid competitive pressures, tariff headwinds, and uncertain consumer spending.
